title: Heatwaves killed over 8,000 people in France this year. Here are some of their stories
subhed: The French health authorities reported that 8,124 deaths were related to the extreme heatwaves between late May and late August in France. Le Monde spoke to the friends and families of 11 of the victims to find out about the lives behind those numbers.

title: US growth remains strong but job creation slows
subhed: The country created just 29,000 jobs in September, well below the 80,000 forecast by analysts. The healthcare sector accounted for most of these new jobs, while financial services has continued to see significant job losses.
